H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H1319: properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H457: good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity; specifically an idol
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1935: grandeur (i.e. an imposing form and appearance)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H8597: ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively)
H4720: a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum
H3051: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
H4940: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H4503: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H2691: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)
H7812: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H2342: properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively, to wait, to pervert
H4427: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
H637: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H8398: the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H4131: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
H1777: a straight course, i.e. sail direct
H4339: evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially)
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H1523: properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear
H7481: to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger)
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H5937: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H3293: a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees)
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H530: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
